label: Глубокий / Неглубокий
description: Глубокий vs неглубокий: deep/shallow contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Глубокий' takes the masculine ending to match 'ручей'. The outdoor scene anchors the form in a concrete observation.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Неглубокая' takes the feminine ending to match 'река'. The sentence places the form in a simple spatial remark.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Глубокое' takes the neuter ending to match 'озеро'. The everyday setting makes the neuter form concrete.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Неглубокие' takes the plural ending to match 'лужи'. The vivid image fixes the plural form in mind.
Strategic focus: Direct masculine contrast. 'Глубокий' is nominative for 'колодец' while 'неглубокого' is genitive after the comparative. The comparison pairs both adjectives in one thought.
Strategic focus: Masculine predicate adjective. 'Неглубокий' follows the noun as a predicate describing 'пруд'. The everyday remark roots the form in daily life.
Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental in the predicate. After past-tense 'была', 'глубокой' takes the feminine instrumental ending to match 'рана'. This shows the быть-plus-instrumental pattern.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental in the predicate. After 'были', 'глубокими' takes the plural instrumental ending to match 'знания'. The sentence extends the pattern into the plural.
Strategic focus: Short-form feminine predicate. The short form 'неглубока' states a present quality of 'вода'. Short forms are typical when describing a current state.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Глубже' is the comparative of 'глубокий' and stays the same for any gender. The sentence compares the centre of the lake to its edge.
